components.name: Glass Tab Bar
components.description: Floating four-destination capsule with an opaque Reduce Transparency fallback.

components.name: Glass Surface
components.description: Neutral white functional grouping surface with a thin edge and soft directional depth.

components.name: Spend Thesis
components.description: Image-backed safe-to-spend statement with a dark contrast overlay and evidence disclosure.

components.name: Penny Conversation
components.description: Conversation-first surface with grounded evidence visualizations and native controls.

narrative.northStar: S-Bank clarity with calm financial-coaching focus
narrative.overview: Penny uses an intentional light canvas, S-Bank's native SF typography, emerald state and purposeful native glass, with dark forest artwork reserved for the Spend hero. Each destination owns one job; financial truth and evidence remain more important than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Four task-led destinations replace the dashboard collage.
Emerald is the only active colour.
One authored image belongs only to the Spend thesis.
The supplied Penny portrait remains unchanged.
Native accessibility fallbacks are part of every material treatment.

rules.name: One Task per Root
rules.body: Spend, Plan, Ask Penny and Incoming each lead with their own primary task.

rules.name: Purposeful Glass
rules.body: Material separates functional layers; it is never stacked as decoration.

rules.name: One Emerald Voice
rules.body: Emerald communicates action, progress and selection only.

rules.name: Financial Truth First
rules.body: No visual treatment may invent, obscure or detach a value from its evidence.
